$description: Structure: shared by every finish. ZAO's base unit is the fen, named after the fen of Yingzao Fashi's cai–fen module. Every spacing and sizing value is a whole or half multiple of it.

unit.$description: 1 fen. The base unit. Tailwind's spacing multiplier is set to this value, so p-3 means 3 fen (12px).

space.$description: Spacing scale in fen. Use these steps only; off-scale values fail lint.

0-5.$description: Half a fen. Hairline gaps only, such as between an icon and a badge.

control.$description: Heights of inputs, selects and tabs, plus small and large Buttons. Identical in every finish so components never change size between themes. Default Button uses size.button.default from its approved reference.

lg.$description: 10 fen. Primary actions on sparse pages.

default.$description: Default Button height in every finish: an 18px label line box and 8px padding above and below, matching the approved Figma reference. Small and large retain the shared 28px and 40px control heights.

hairline.$description: Shared width for fine borders, rules and ruler marks. Independent of finish depth so essential strokes and component geometry remain stable when paint offsets change.
